title: Ligand field variations: tuning the toroidal moment of Dy6 rings

synthesis.procedure: Main text: direct reaction of Dy(NO3)3·6H2O with Me-teaH3 and NEt3 at a Dy:ligand ratio of 1:2 (details in the ESI). SI: a solution of Dy(NO3)3·6H2O (written Ln(NO3)3·6H2O; 0.228 g, 0.5 mmol) and 1-[N,N-bis(2-hydroxyethyl)amino]-2-propanol (Me-teaH3; 0.326 g, 2 mmol) in MeCN/MeOH (18/14 mL) was stirred at 60 °C for 10 min. Triethylamine (0.3 mL) was added and the mixture was refluxed for a further 20 min. The clear solution was left undisturbed in air; after 1 day, colorless block-like crystals were collected.
synthesis.time: 10 min at 60 °C, then 20 min reflux; crystals after 1 day
synthesis.vessel_or_method: stirred solution in air, then reflux; crystallization by standing in air
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Left undisturbed in air; colorless block-like crystals collected after 1 day

properties.summary: Dc susceptibility of the Dy6 ring resembles the parent toroidal {Dy6} wheel, with no room-temperature moment reduction versus six non-interacting Dy(III) ions. Magnetization at 2 K shows a toroidal-to-ferromagnetic level-crossing inflection at higher field than for 3. The anisotropy-axis angle to the S6 axis is 34°. Ac susceptibility shows a fast process with no χ'' maximum in the experimental window, even under an applied dc field.

measurements.name: anisotropy-axis angle to S6 axis
measurements.conditions: from fit of low-temperature magnetization; compared with 43° for the parent compound 1

measurements.name: magnetization inflection
measurements.conditions: 2 K; first derivative of M vs H; higher field than compound 3

synthesis.procedure: Main text: direct reaction of Dy(NO3)3·6H2O with apadH4 and a reduced amount of NEt3, Dy:ligand ratio 1:2 (ESI). SI: Dy(NO3)3·6H2O (0.46 g, 1 mmol) and 3-aminopropyldiethanolamine (apdeaH4/apadH4; 0.336 g, 2 mmol) in CH3CN/THF (40/10 mL) were stirred at room temperature for 10 min, then triethylamine (0.2 mL) was added. The mixture was heated at 80 °C for 10 min. The clear colorless solution was left undisturbed in air; after 1 day, colorless crystals were collected.
synthesis.time: 10 min at room temperature, then 10 min at 80 °C; crystals after 1 day
synthesis.vessel_or_method: stirred solution, then heating; crystallization by standing in air
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Left undisturbed in air; colorless crystals collected after 1 day

properties.summary: Amino-arm substitution enlarges the toroidal moment relative to the parent wheel and gives a higher thermally activated barrier. Zero-field relaxation is dominated by a small barrier and quantum tunnelling; under 2 kOe a thermally activated Orbach-like process appears. Dc curves track compound 2 above 50 K but differ at 10–30 K, consistent with a smaller toroidal–ferromagnetic gap.
